bullets: Contributing to the ManageMyTeam (MMT) application by developing enhancements, resolving 20+ application defects, and implementing backend changes across multiple business workflows.
Developing and maintaining 10+ backend services using C# and .NET, supporting database operations and application integrations across core MMT functionality.
Using Git and Azure DevOps across Agile development cycles for source control, work-item tracking, defect resolution, and delivery of application changes through regular releases.
Delivered features for 2 enterprise applications — CAM360 (Client Audit Management System) and MARS (Metric Analysis & Reporting Suite) — using .NET Core, .NET Framework, AngularJS, and SQL Server.
Built and optimised 20+ API endpoints using C#, Entity Framework Core, Dapper ORM, and SQL Server, supporting data access and business workflows across CAM360 and MARS.
Engineered 10+ Angular modules and integrated REST APIs using Bootstrap, with GitHub and Postman for source control, API testing, and application development.
Implemented RESTful Web APIs using .NET Core, Entity Framework, and SQL Server, improving application efficiency by 50% across API-driven workflows.
Applied JWT-based authentication and authorisation across 10+ API endpoints, enabling role-based access control and secure user sessions.
Created 5+ Angular and TypeScript UI components with Bootstrap and integrated REST APIs to support application workflows and data operations.
